description: This file defines a configuration class for integrating Google Generative AI models with Vertex AI. It includes methods for environment validation, parameter mapping, and request transformation specific to Vertex AI's API expectations.

classes.name: VertexAIGoogleGenAIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for calling Google models via Vertex AI, inheriting from GoogleGenAIConfig. It provides methods to validate environment variables, convert parameter naming conventions, and transform generate content requests for the Vertex AI API.

methods.name: Literal["gemini","vertex_ai"] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns a string literal indicating that this configuration uses the 'vertex_ai' provider.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, api_key: Optional[str], headers: Optional[dict], model: str, litellm_params: Optional[Union[GenericLiteLLMParams, dict]], )
methods.description: Validates and constructs the headers for the environment, incorporating API keys and additional headers.

methods.name: str _camel_to_snake(self, camel_str: str)
methods.description: Utility method to convert camelCase strings to snake_case.

methods.name: map_generate_content_optional_params( self, generate_content_config_dict, model: str, )
methods.description: Maps parameters from Google GenAI format to provider-specific snake_case format.

methods.name: dict transform_generate_content_request( self, model: str, contents: Any, tools: Optional[Any], generate_content_config_dict: Dict, system_instruction: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms request data into the format expected by Vertex AI, including optional tools, system instructions, and generation configuration.

ctags.signature: ( self, model: str, contents: Any, tools: Optional[Any], generate_content_config_dict: Dict, system_instruction: Optional[Any] = None, )

ctags.signature: ( self, api_key: Optional[str], headers: Optional[dict], model: str, litellm_params: Optional[Union[GenericLiteLLMParams, dict]], )
